instruction: Extract from Invoices/photo of invoice.jpg: worker name, and each billed line (date, hours or start/end times, amount). Schema: {worker, lines:[{date, hours, start, end, amount}], total}

ug-surveillance event-timeline for the Front Door camera, start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00, end-time 2026-11-08T23:59:59, timezone America/New_York, topic Human, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz, limit 200. Return every event with timestamp.
ug-document extract --file "Invoices/photo of invoice.jpg" --query "billed dates, hours and amounts per line" --schema "{lines:[{date,hours,amount}],total}"
